requirement: Implement audit_logged decorator preserving wrapped function metadata via functools.wraps and HandlerRegistry with capacity bounds and stats tracking.
skeleton: audit_logged decorator function and HandlerRegistry class with register, execute, get_doc, and clear methods.

rationale.teaches: A logging decorator that preserves the wrapped function's name and docstring with functools.wraps, a registry that rejects non-callables, allows exactly 20 handlers, looks up by presence, and clears its stats.
rationale.why: A decorator without wraps still runs the function; only introspection of __name__ and __doc__ reveals the loss. The fixture reads them, which is what documentation and tooling do.

candidates.why_wrong: functools.wraps is omitted, so every decorated handler reports the name wrapper and loses its docstring.
A non-callable is accepted as a handler, so execution fails later with TypeError instead of at registration.
The capacity check uses >, so a 21st handler is accepted.
The membership checks are inverted, so execute and get_doc raise for registered handlers and proceed for unknown ones.
clear removes handlers but keeps stats, so call counts survive a reset.
